requirements:
generate a hotel architecture diagram

--- CLARIFIED REQUIREMENTS ---
[SCALE] What is the expected scale of the hotel management system in terms of concurrent users and transactions per second?: Medium scale (100-1000 users)
[SECURITY] Are there specific security or compliance standards the architecture must adhere to (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS)?: PCI DSS
[INTEGRATION] Does the architecture need to integrate with existing hotel systems such as booking platforms, CRM, or payment gateways?: No
[PERFORMANCE] What are the performance targets for the system, such as latency and throughput requirements?: Medium latency (100-500ms)
[BUSINESS] Is there a specific budget or cost constraint for designing and operating the architecture?: Medium budget ($10K-$50K/month)
[ARCHITECTURE] What are the disaster recovery and availability requirements for the architecture (e.g., RTO, RPO)?: Intermediate (RTO < 4 hours, RPO < 4 hours)
